reason: The free part is enough for me to test it on my child for a few weeks, and the English letters are the only thing I really care about. I won't pay for PRO until I see it actually teaches something and until I know I can pay without fighting with a foreign card or store billing.
objection: I can't easily pay through Google Play or the App Store with my local card, and I don't want to give my child another screen app that is a cartoon dressed up as a lesson.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to pay with Click, Payme or Uzcard/Humo, after my child clearly learns English letters with the free version in a couple of weeks.
